description: C11 — 法国防御古典变例，兵链概念引入

intro.popup_en: Pawn-Chain Direction, Lesson 1: The direction of a pawn chain points toward the side where you should attack. The e5-d4 chain points toward White's kingside, so White should advance there with f4 and g4.
intro.popup:
兵链方向第1课
核心法则：
兵链的倾斜方向=进攻方向！
e5-d4链向右上方倾斜
→白方必须向王翼（f4→g4）进攻！

outro.popup_en: White establishes the chain with e5, supports it with f4, then launches the attack with h4 and g4. Each pawn advance follows the direction of the chain.
outro.popup:
总结：e5确立兵链 → f4支撑 → h4-g4总攻
每步都沿兵链方向前进！

moves.popup_en: e4 controls the center and prepares a later e5 advance.
...e6 begins the French Defense, preparing the e6-d5 structure to challenge White's center.
moves.popup: 法国防御！e6-d5对抗白方中心

moves.popup_en: d4 establishes the base of White's pawn chain. The e5-d4 chain is beginning to take shape.
moves.popup: d4建立兵链根部！e5-d4链开始成形

moves.popup_en: ...d5! Black responds symmetrically and builds a matching central structure.
moves.popup: d5！黑方针锋相对建立对称

moves.popup_en: Nc3 supports e4 and prepares White's e5 advance.
...Nf6! The knight challenges White's center.
Bg5 pins Black's knight and prepares e5.
...Be7 breaks the pin and develops safely.
e5!! White establishes the pawn chain e5-d4-c3. The direction of the chain points White toward a kingside attack.
moves.popup:
e5！！兵链形成！e5-d4-c3链确立
白方王翼进攻方向已定！

moves.popup_en: ...Nfd7 retreats the knight as the pawn chain restricts its natural squares.
moves.popup: Nfd7！马被迫后撤，兵链威力显现

moves.popup_en: Bxe7 simplifies the position and prevents Black's knight from returning to the pinning square.
...Qxe7 recaptures the bishop with the queen.
f4!! White advances in the direction of the chain. The pawn supports e5 and prepares f5 against Black's kingside.
moves.popup:
f4！！沿兵链方向推进！
f4支撑e5，准备f5向黑王翼冲锋

moves.popup_en: ...O-O secures Black's king on the kingside.
Nf3 develops and coordinates White's pieces around the center.
...c5! Black correctly attacks the base of White's pawn chain on d4.
moves.popup: c5！黑方攻击兵链根部d4——正确反击！

moves.popup_en: Qd2! White prepares queenside castling. With the king heading to the queenside, White can attack on the kingside while Black seeks counterplay there.
moves.popup:
Qd2❗长易位准备！白王去后翼
王翼全力进攻，双翼竞速开始

moves.popup_en: ...Nc6 reinforces Black's position and prepares queenside play.
moves.popup: Nc6增援，黑方准备后翼进攻

moves.popup_en: dxc5! White accepts the exchange and simplifies the pawn structure.
moves.popup: dxc5！白方接受交换，简化结构

moves.popup_en: ...Nxc5! Black's knight occupies the important square c5.
O-O-O!! The opposite-wing race begins. White's king is safe on the queenside, freeing the kingside pieces and pawns to attack.
moves.popup:
O-O-O！！双翼竞速开始！
白王安全在后翼，王翼全力攻击

moves.popup_en: ...a6! Black defends and prepares a queenside counterattack with ...b5.
h4!! White launches the kingside attack. The h4-g4 advance follows the direction of the pawn-chain head.
moves.popup:
h4！！王翼总攻！
h4-g4将沿兵链头部方向全力冲锋！

moves.popup_en: ...b5! Black counterattacks on the queenside, following the direction of Black's own pawn chain.
Kb1! The king steps away from the diagonal and becomes safer.
...b4! Black continues the queenside pawn advance.
Ne2 reroutes the knight, preparing to support White's kingside attack.
...a5! Black's queenside pawn chain continues to advance.
moves.popup: a5！黑方后翼兵链继续前进

moves.popup_en: g4!! White reaches the climax of the kingside attack. The pawn advances along the direction of the chain as both sides race on opposite wings.
moves.popup:
g4！！王翼总攻高潮！
g4沿兵链方向前进——双翼竞速！
